authority.alpha_prerequisite: Give every developer and AI host one reproducible Linux workspace whose toolchains, native build dependencies, and optional pgvector service equal the candidate-CI pins, so the checked-in presubmit, focused engine tests, and SDK conformance run locally with the same tool identity that J-02 release evidence must record, without making the container a second CI, lifecycle, or RRFlow runtime authority.

current_behavior: At clean baseline 676fe533 no Containerfile, Dockerfile, devcontainer, or compose file exists anywhere in repository history. Candidate CI pins Rust 1.98.0, Python 3.11.16, uv 0.11.21, Node 24.20.0, pnpm 11.22.0, Go 1.24.13, Temurin 21.0.12.1+1, Maven 3.9.12 (SHA-512), .NET SDK 10.0.111, and a digest-pinned pgvector service, but those pins exist only in GitHub Actions setup steps. A Windows checkout therefore diverges: core.filemode reports executable-bit loss on 13 scripts, python3 resolves to the Microsoft Store stub, and 14 of 20 scripts/ci/test_change_plan.py cases fail because fixtures written in text mode gain CRLF bytes that no longer match their LF digests. Nothing checks that a local environment matches CI.
target_behavior: One .devcontainer directory supplies a digest-pinned Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 Containerfile with a lean rust target (Rust 1.98.0 with clippy/rustfmt, native C/C++ build dependencies, uv 0.11.21 and Python 3.11.16 as python3) and a full target that adds the exact CI SDK toolchains; every download is verified against an embedded SHA-256 or SHA-512. devcontainer.json builds the rust target for VS Code with rootless-Podman user mapping and no lifecycle command; compose.yaml drives the same image from the Podman CLI with named source and cache volumes and an opt-in pgvector profile using the CI image digest and credentials. A seed script clones committed history from a read-only mount of an existing checkout into the source volume and restores its remotes, so work happens on a native Linux filesystem. scripts/ci/check_workflow.py fails when any container toolchain pin, checksum, base or service image digest, or the pgvector test identity diverges from rust-toolchain.toml and ci-reusable.yml. docs/operations/ci.md documents the workspace as local reproduction, never as CI evidence or a hook.
unchanged_behavior: README, objective, roadmap, and POA&M retain identity, outcome, status, and deficiency authority; no gate, checkbox, or deficiency changes status.
Candidate CI jobs, triggers, runners, action pins, ci-gate reduction, and the ARC deployment remain unchanged; the container is local reproduction and cannot satisfy or replace pipeline / ci-gate.
No Git, editor, provider, or RRFlow runtime hook is added: devcontainer.json declares no postCreate, postStart, or other lifecycle command, and AGENTS.md hook policy is untouched.
No Rust source, Cargo manifest, Cargo.lock, SDK source, generated product surface, dependency, protocol, version 1.0.0, or remote/promotion configuration changes.

The RRFlow default distribution, installation path, and offline runtime contract are unaffected; container toolchain downloads are development build inputs like the CI setup actions, never RRFlow install-time or runtime fetches.
The Windows checkout remains supported for editing; the Windows-only CRLF fixture defect in scripts/ci/test_change_plan.py is characterized, not fixed, by this package.

implementation_changes.action: Create a digest-pinned ubuntu:24.04 amd64 multi-stage image: rust target with native build dependencies, rustup 1.29.1, Rust 1.98.0 plus clippy/rustfmt, uv 0.11.21, and Python 3.11.16 as python3; full target adding Node 24.20.0, pnpm 11.22.0, Go 1.24.13, Temurin 21.0.12.1+1, Maven 3.9.12, and .NET SDK 10.0.111 with ICU. Every artifact is verified with sha256sum/sha512sum --check --strict against an embedded ARG. Run as non-root uid 1000 with caches under /cache.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The build fails on any checksum mismatch, missing tool, or version drift; an unpinned base image, :latest tag, or unverified download is a policy failure.

implementation_changes.action: Build the rust target from the Containerfile for VS Code Dev Containers with rootless-Podman keep-id user mapping, host networking for loopback parity with CI, and the shared cache volume; declare no lifecycle command.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Fail review if it declares postCreate/postStart/updateContent/initialize commands, a second toolchain source, or credentials.

implementation_changes.action: Drive the same image from the Podman CLI with a named Linux source volume, a read-only seed mount of the invoking checkout, a shared cache volume, and an opt-in pgvector profile whose digest, database, user, password, and 127.0.0.1:5432 endpoint equal candidate CI.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Policy fails if the pgvector image or test identity diverges from ci-reusable.yml or any image lacks a SHA-256 digest.

implementation_changes.action: Clone committed history from the read-only seed mount into an empty source volume, check out the seed branch, and restore the seed repository's remote URLs without copying credentials or uncommitted files.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Refuse a non-empty destination, a missing seed repository, or an unresolved branch; never overwrite existing work.

implementation_changes.action: Add a development-container policy check that parses Containerfile ARG pins and compose images and requires equality with rust-toolchain.toml and the ci-reusable.yml toolchain, Maven checksum, and pgvector service identity, digest-pinned images, strict checksum verification, and no devcontainer lifecycle command.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Exit non-zero naming the divergent pin, image, checksum, or lifecycle field; existing CI policy checks remain unchanged.
